concrete_scene.heading: Concrete scene: a causal method arrives as persuasive prose
concrete_scene.actor_or_system: A research agent, retrieved causal-method paper, Cognitive Technology Record compiler, qualified protocol runtime, and authority gate
concrete_scene.attempted_action: Answer whether a hospital alarm improved outcomes by applying remembered causal language without binding required variables, assumptions, diagnostics, or stop conditions.
concrete_scene.observable_outcome: The protocol preflight rejects execution when treatment assignment, timing, target regime, or overlap evidence is absent, while retaining every unresolved translation residual.
concrete_scene.failed_or_tested_boundary: The scene tests whether possession of a method description counts as faithful execution or permission to act; neither inference is accepted.
concrete_scene.residual_owner: Source interpretation, method realization, qualification, empirical assurance, runtime execution, and clinical authority retain distinct owners and versioned residuals.
concrete_scene.evidence_boundary: The scene demonstrates typed method custody and fail-closed routing; it does not establish semantic extraction accuracy, causal validity, benchmark advantage, evaluator independence, or safe autonomous use.

worked_trace.heading: Worked trace: from method claim to qualified protocol
worked_trace.maximum_inference: Records, typed protocols, qualification evidence, and bounded invocation can preserve distinct method states; transport fidelity, efficacy, security, legitimacy, and safe autonomy remain unproven.

counterexample_or_simpler_baseline: The prompt-only baseline retrieves method prose and improvises missing obligations. The qualified route rejects absent diagnostics and preserves uncertainty rather than inventing execution evidence.
readable_claim: Civilizational methods should enter an AI stack only through a governed transfer-and-qualification pipeline that preserves a source Cognitive Technology Record, tests mechanism-preserving target realizations, compiles an explicitly scoped Qualified Cognitive Protocol, and keeps qualification, execution assurance, and authority independent across inheritance, execution, and evolution.
normative_rule: No protocol can certify its own qualification, promote its own revision, or widen its own authority.

caveat_consolidation.local_caveat: The causal-method trace states once that protocol custody is not method validity or authority.
caveat_consolidation.consolidated_disposition: Extraction, transport, qualification, assurance, execution, authority, support, and release remain independent states.

bookkeeping_surface_disposition: The paper, missing diagnostics, protocol rejection, and authority boundary remain reader-facing; complete CTR and QCP fields remain on the formal surface.

editorial_diagnostics.mega_sentence_disposition: The scene turns five transfer gaps into one observable preflight rejection.
editorial_diagnostics.hedge_disposition: The trace closes with one explicit maximum-inference boundary.
editorial_diagnostics.table_disposition: The lifecycle and axis tables remain because they prevent qualification, assurance, and authority collapse.

non_claims: Schema conformance does not establish method efficacy or faithful transport.
Protocol qualification does not confer clinical or institutional authority.
The editorial packet does not change support or release state.
